plugin.description: Control lights, climate, covers, media players, locks and scenes in Home Assistant (requires a running Home Assistant instance)
plugin.name: Home Assistant Smart Home
panel.control.ph: Enter a device name, e.g. living room light
panel.control.title: Query device state
panel.devices.col.name: Name
panel.devices.empty: No devices yet. After connecting, click Refresh devices.
panel.devices.title: Devices
panel.hint.encrypted: The token is stored encrypted on this machine ({backend}); only your user account can decrypt it.
panel.hint.noEncrypt: No encryption backend is available on this system, so the token is kept in memory only — you will need to re-enter it after restarting N.E.K.O.
panel.hint.token: The address is pre-filled with http://127.0.0.1:8123 — keep it if HA runs on this same machine, otherwise use its IP. The token stays on this machine and is never uploaded.
panel.msg.needFields: Please fill in both URL and token
panel.setup.step2: 2. Create a long-lived token under Profile → Security and paste it
panel.setup.step3: 3. Click Save and connect, then control devices in plain language
panel.setup.title: Three steps
panel.subtitle: Connect your Home Assistant and control the whole house with one sentence.
panel.whitelist.hint: Low-risk devices (lights, fans, media players, scenes, ordinary curtains) are allowed by default. Switches and climate are controllable but worth reviewing. High-risk devices (locks, garage doors, gas valves, water heaters, alarm panels) are blocked and must be enabled one by one — and even then, every action still needs a second confirmation.
panel.whitelist.title: Control permissions
